title: Saffron Rice with Saithe
blurb: Fragrant saffron rice cooked with garlic and onion, topped with pan-fried saithe fillets.
steps: Soak the saffron threads in two tablespoons of warm water and set aside. Peel and finely chop the onion and garlic.
Heat half the olive oil in a wide pan over medium heat, add the onion and garlic, and cook for five minutes until softened.

Stir in the rice and cook for one minute, then add the saffron with its soaking water, the vegetable stock, and half the salt. Bring to a simmer, cover, and cook for fifteen minutes until the rice is tender and the liquid absorbed.

Meanwhile, pat the saithe fillets dry and season with the remaining salt and black pepper. Heat the remaining olive oil in a frying pan over medium-high heat and cook the fillets for three to four minutes on each side until golden and cooked through.
Fluff the rice with a fork and divide between two plates. Top with the saithe fillets and serve with lemon wedges.
